time_discretization: exponential RC step with frozen midpoint constitutive coefficient and trapezoidal current
input_contract: initial SOC/polarization, current profile, times; no future voltage input
training_initialization: Each training window conditions on first observed voltage and SOC derived from accumulated charge. Loss excludes that anchor. Validation selection uses same conditional windows. Test evaluation is a full open-loop profile from its first observation only.
physics_contract: SOC and RC dynamics embedded as in voltage_mlp; Kirchhoff equality is a soft loss only; no hard voltage or inequality projection
